meta.name: diffdock
meta.description: DiffDock and DiffDock-L molecular docking. Use for protein-small-molecule pose prediction from PDB or sequence plus SMILES/SDF/MOL2, batch docking, virtual screening, and pose-confidence interpretation. Not for binding affinity prediction.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 预测药物分子怎样结合蛋白质
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果在药物研发中需要判断化合物如何结合靶蛋白。
copy.tagline_en: Predict how drug molecules bind to proteins
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you work on drug discovery and need to see how small molecules bind to a target protein.

howto.what: Claude 可以用 DiffDock 预测小分子配体在蛋白上的 3D 结合姿态:输入 PDB 或蛋白序列加 SMILES/SDF/MOL2,产出带置信度分数的 SDF 姿态文件,支持单个或批量对接与虚拟筛选。它不预测结合亲和力。
howto.when: 当你要求做分子对接、预测结合姿态,或进行虚拟筛选、批量对接蛋白-配体对时触发;典型输入是 PDB 文件或序列搭配 SMILES/SDF/MOL2。

say.text: 把这个配体 dock 到蛋白 protein.pdb 上,预测结合姿态。
say.note: 生成带置信度分数的 SDF 姿态文件。

say.text: 用 batch_input.csv 批量对接这些蛋白-配体对。
say.note: 结果写入指定的输出目录。

say.text: 分析 results/batch/ 的置信度分数,导出前 5 名。

howto.what_en: Claude can run DiffDock to predict 3D binding poses of small-molecule ligands on proteins: input a PDB file or sequence plus SMILES/SDF/MOL2, and it returns SDF pose files with confidence scores. It does not predict binding affinity.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to dock a ligand to a protein, predict a binding pose, or run virtual screening and batch docking of protein-ligand pairs, typically with PDB plus SMILES input.

say_en.text: Dock this ligand to protein.pdb and predict its binding pose.
say_en.note: Writes SDF pose files with confidence scores.

say_en.text: Batch dock these protein-ligand pairs using batch_input.csv.
say_en.note: Results go to the output directory.

say_en.text: Analyze confidence scores in results/batch/ and export the top 5.
say_en.note: Prints a summary and a CSV.
